test_case_when: test the CASE WHEN SQL expression with COALESCE and modulo arithmetic in Polars SQLContext
test_case_when_optional_else: test CASE WHEN with optional ELSE NULL clause using df.sql() on a Polars DataFrame
test_control_flow_functions: test SQL control flow functions COALESCE, NULLIF, IFNULL, and IF in Polars SQL queries
test_greatest_least: test GREATEST and LEAST SQL functions with numeric, string, and date columns in Polars
test_sql_syntax_error: test that IFNULL and NULLIF raise SQLSyntaxError when called with incorrect argument count
